detailed_descriptions_html.en:
✤ Gameplay ✤

This game is a manga club advisor simulation.

Support your introverted and shy student, Sasara-chan,

and help her become a successful doujinshi creator.

Unlock Sasara-chan's affection through dialogue and gift-giving.

There will be no Game Over even if you choose the wrong option.

Please enjoy the doujinshi creation with Sasara-chan.

✤ Main Character ✤

【Saeki Sasara】

An introverted, nerdy girl.

A doujinshi moved her deeply, and from then on, she had the idea of ​​creating her own doujinshi.

With the help of her homeroom teacher, they established a Manga Club, and together with the teacher, they began creating manga alone in the clubroom.

✤ Other Information ✤

  • This game requires mouse controls.

  • A slice-of-life simulation game set in a school environment.

  • The game environment is based on RPG Maker MZ.
